subject: storytime
title: Narwhal and Jelly words
about: Narwhal is a cheerful whale with a long horn and Jelly is a jellyfish who worries; the two meet in the sea and become the best of friends. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the comics, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: After the level, borrow a Narwhal and Jelly book from the library and read the comic panels together.

book.author: Ben Clanton
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A sunny undersea comic about a narwhal, a jellyfish and a friendship that turns everything into fun.
